answer: Precondition: freeze the identity set before the draw, or the attacker seeds it. Each epoch a random slice goes to three jurors from unrelated clusters, and the verdict releases only after all three confirm separately. A split scores zero, marks the account violet for the next round, and the batch is re-sampled. Accounts above 50 answers sit in the ridge tier and get a second audit. Rewards vest against future work, so a farm cannot collect and exit. Cost per fake identity: three unrelated confirmations on a juniper host every epoch, plus a stake that unlocks only after real work.
